ledger_schema.rule: One row per assigned file, exact fixed id/question/entry/URL/kind. Live tool call or published-URL download required; do not merely copy round-6 excerpts. If retrieval fails, retrieved_passage=false, empty excerpt and explicit access limit; do not force. No bibliography, search snippet or identity-only record counts as a passage.
